purpose: Add a second contextual example to common place and travel headwords in the existing English baseline.

addExamples: The station was crowded with commuters during the morning rush.
The weekend market sells handmade crafts as well as fresh food.
Students often use the library when they need a quiet place to work.
The new hospital has a separate entrance for emergency patients.
The restaurant is fully booked for Saturday evening.
Our class visited the museum to see an exhibition of ancient tools.
A security guard checked our passes at the entrance.
Follow the green signs to find the emergency exit.
There is a small bakery on the corner opposite the bank.
The old bridge was closed while workers inspected its structure.
You can show the digital ticket on your phone when you enter.
Passengers waited on the platform until the train arrived.
